verdict.rationale: Netlify's docs say it offers built-in "simple password protection for a personal portfolio site", which matches the story of protecting a deployed site without a custom auth system. A related claim says new projects stay private until published. The evidence is only a one-line summary, though: it gives no setup steps, no detail on whether protection is site-wide or per-deploy, and no plan requirements. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how password protection is configured and scoped, plan or tier availability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
